Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

Cindy, Roland, Seni and Christian share a common passion, free-diving in the lakes of Romandy. Whether in search of the mysteries of the deep, or the simple pleasure of being embraced by the water, exploring the depths also reveals their inner nature.

Clémence d'Ennery unveils her collection of Asian works in a Paris hotel. Using porcelain petals, Juliette Clovis opens up a luminous, dreamlike world. At Rabanne, we push the boundaries of women's dressing with bold materials. Immerse yourself in the studio of artist Marion Mezenge.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Painter and creator of unique mural decors, the artist Solène Eloy is inspired by the fresco painting technique. Everything you need to know about the design of the first Air Max. In Normandy, stopover at Villedieu-les-Poêles, in the heart of L'Atelier du cuivre. The chic way to wear jogging bottoms.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

Amongst the vines of Lavaux, the World Tracassets Championships is a spring carnival where anything goes. The tracassets, small three-wheeled tractors, were built in the 1950s to work the steep slopes of the vineyards. To compete in the famous race, each has been meticulously customised.

We're off to the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Tours! In the heart of Paris, mosaic artist Luigi La Ferla builds and deconstructs his works. With Mame Kurogouchi, shape is sculpted from the body itself. Painter Camille Viry brings her landscapes to life using traditional decorative painting techniques.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

The Marathon de la Mode Durable: a runway show designed to showcase the creativity of the IFA Paris students. Focus on seersucker, a fabric we know so well but without realising it. Moirans en Montagne makes high quality wooden toys. How to wear a bathrobe.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

Welcome to very Francophile Albania, where the French language has left its mark on history. First stop, Korça, the cradle of Albanian Francophonie, home to the French military cemetery and the first French high school founded in the Balkans. Then on to Gjirokastër, the stone city, and Berat, the city of a thousand windows.
Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

Mireille Keïta builds bridges between the country that offered her a home, Switzerland, and her native Africa. She is the organiser of the Yelen Africa Festival in Baulmes, showcasing the advantages of cultural mixity. The profits are then used to improve people's lives in several villages in Mali.

In Boulogne-Billancourt, visit the Musée des Années 30. Stefania Di Petrillo explores the emotional dimensions of design. Artistic director Pieter Mulier is following in the footsteps of the founder of the Alaïa fashion house: sophistication at its best. The organic forms of an omnipresent nature are embodied in the creations of cabinetmaker Maxime Goléo.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

The Pyramid, Vila 31, the College of Europe... Discover Tirana, the vibrant Albanian capital, in the company of Thomas Frasheri. Dive into the festive atmosphere of the Albanian Night, then enjoy an exceptional meeting with Edi Rama, the very Francophile Prime Minister. Final stop, Shkodër, the cycling capital, and its fascinating Marubi museum.

Leather is his preferred means of expression, we meet flamboyant designer Jean-Claude Jitrois. Nylon revolutionised the textile industry: but where did its name come from? Near Agde, the small town of Pezenas is home to stone carvers, cabinet-makers, artisan metalworkers, glass-makers... Minimalist and practical, how to wear a boob tube.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

Max Brumberg, flute designer, has set himself a challenge: that of resurrecting the aulos, an instrument that has lain forgotten for 2,000 years. Resembling a recorder, the aulos produces an enchanting, magical note. In classical times, it was said to hypnotise and bewitch the listening crowds.

Off to Montreal to discover the Musée des Beaux-Arts. Guided by meditation, Mathias Bensimon creates profound and luminous canvases. Haider Ackermann expresses the sensuality and eroticism so dear to Tom Ford, while adding a touch of poetry and gentleness. Sculptor Salomé Cousseau shapes wood with passion and elegance.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Palais Galliera and Ulgador display their most exquisite creations with grace and sophistication. Ceramic artist Sarah-Linda Forrer and Marie-Hélène Poisson's Atelier MHP preserve and modernise exceptional know-how. Weaving and industrial design reinvented with the high-warp looms at the Font & Romani Paris workshop and with Victoria Wilmotte.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

Welcome to Kosovo, the youngest state in Europe, perhaps the least known of the Balkans. Discover the must-see places and the cultural and gastronomic riches of Pristina, the vibrant capital, with Desantila Muriqi, a committed young Kosovar. Then visit the remains of Ulpiana, the Pompeii of the Balkans, with archaeologist Ilir Culaj.
Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

Feet firmly on the ground but her mind in the world of cutting-edge technology, the artist Camille Scherrer brings enchantment to everyday reality through her interactive works that add a touch of fun to their poetic beauty.

The Maison des Canuts traces the long tradition of Lyon's gold, silver and silk weavers. Each creation by visual artist Sarah Valente sounds like a call from the forest. Zomer is turning fashion upside down. In Brittany, craftsman Thibaut Thierry works paper with seaweed.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

At the Élysée Palace, the 4th "Made in France" fair, veritable showcase for French know-how, welcomes 122 companies. All about the origins of rhinestones, and how they revolutionised the art of jewellery-making. Alençon, in Normandy, global benchmark in the exceptional craft of lacemaking. How to wear gaiters.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

Heading to Prizren, a magnificent city with its cobbled streets, Ottoman houses and medieval charm. Then Gjakova, a warm town with a rich mercantile past, and Peja, the temple of judo, a national pride. The journey ends in the spectacular landscapes of Rugova National Park.
Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

Sébastien Guenot is an unusual artist on the margins of several worlds. Through his drawings, created on several different media, he expresses the profound emotions he experiences in his dreams. A journey through the landscapes of the Swiss Jura and their mysterious clearings.

In the heart of Brittany, visit the Pont-Aven museum. Interior design and a passion for cinema come together in Sandra Benhamou's world. Lacoste reinvents itself under the leadership of Pelagia Kolotouros. Patient and meticulous, restorer Marie-Cécile Kfouri brings frescoes and old canvases back to life.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

François Monthoux is an enthusiastic artist from the Vaud, with a notable passion for ants, Nietzsche, and the seasons of the year. Painter, sculptor, philosopher, the permanent effervescence of his mind leads him to create works steeped in poetry, sometimes directly in the heart of nature.

The Albert-Kahn museum unveils the banker's humanist project. Sometimes called "the time folder", Simone Pheulpin works with cotton ribbon. For his first show at Dries Van Noten, Julian Klausner plays with textures and colours. Sophie Brillouet's studio is alive with beach air.

Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.
Gerry brings a unique dimension to his street art, set in a world where poetry meets mechanics. And it all began during a long journey through India by bicycle, a voyage in search of his roots.

Visit the Yves Saint Laurent museum and meet the great couturier. Somewhere between cinema and pop culture, Julien Fournié is deploying his art of haute couture on the red carpets. Jean Paul Gaultier invites Simone Rocha to revisit his archives. Micro or macro embroidery: Cyrielle Leclère steps outside the traditional framework.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

The Pic du Midi scientific observatory has proudly dominated the Pyrenees, 2,877 metres above sea-level, for one hundred and forty years. Notably specialising in the study of the sun's corona, the site is today open to the public, offering a fabulous panorama and unique experience to all who visit.

Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

For Pierre Chatelain, preparing recipes with mediaeval flavour is a sacred quest that brings pure happiness. Using produce that is authentic, local and seasonal he sets out to surprise our palate with unknown flavours that take us back to the world of yesteryear.

The Cité du vitrail in Troyes traces almost ten centuries of history. In Paris, textile artist Aude Franjou's linen sculpture has taken up position inside the July Column on Place de la Bastille. In a theatrical spirit, Palomo Spain blurs genres. Meet artist and cabinetmaker Maxim, creator of the Oodelally workshop.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Between Suriname and Brazil, French Guiana is the only French department in South America. The adventure begins in Maripasoula, on the Maroni River, with a canoe trip to discover traditional Bushinengue villages. Stops in Papaïchton and Bélikampo, then Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni, whose history remains marked by the penal colony.

Natural slow-risen sourdough bread, its thick crust cracking with every bite. Rich in flavour, made with local flour, it keeps well and is filled with childhood memories. Bread made by two artisan bakers sharing a bakery in the heart of Geneva: Jérôme Saugy and Sarah Bertin.

On the outskirts of Fontainebleau, the Musée des Peintres de Barbizon traces the history of Impressionism. A self-taught chef turned Michelin-starred chef, Guy Martin looks back on his gastronomic career at the Grand Véfour. Time travel with Chemena Kamali, at the helm of Chloé. The art of straw marquetry with Stéphanie Trolez.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

An exciting journey across Morocco to meet the men and women who keep the French language alive. Cosmopolitan Tangier opens this trip, with playwright Zoubeir Benbouchta introducing us to his hometown. Then on to Tétouan, a city between tradition and innovation, Sidi Kacem, and Guercif.

In Angers, in a 12th-century building, discover tapestries by Jean Lurçat alongside ancient textile works. The world of designer Alix Waline unfolds on both a small and large scale. At the Château de Versailles, Jacquemus pays tribute to his family's farming roots. Alain Ellouz transcends light through stone.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

We head off to discover a dream of a garden above Lake Thun, that of Bettina and Wilfried Courage. Creating a series of different areas around their chalet has enabled them to design and plant exactly as they wanted to: moon, sun, box, water, autumn, rockery and rose gardens.

Journalist Sarah Jabri introduces us to the cultural wealth of Meknès and its region. Visit to Ben Guérir, a strong example of Moroccan educational dynamism, and to Mohammed VI University. The journey ends in Western Sahara, in Laâyoune and Tarfaya, with a visit to the Saint-Exupéry Museum.
Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

Jérôme Lair, instrument maker, and Robert Mercier, leather specialist, showcase skilled trades thanks to their expertise. The chef Thierry Marx and the interior decorator Sarah Lavoine present French art of living. The right way to wear or mix black and white and also draped fashion.
Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

At the Fourneau Saint-Michel, accompanied by Thierry Petit, Adrien goes out to meet people who need a "green" experience. This quest for well-being is also accompanied by music, thanks to the talent of accordionist Didier Laloy.
